MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The heat shrink tubing and sealed splice connectors feel like natural additions to my earlier crimp terminals because they help insulate and protect wiring repairs.",
    "Adhesive-lined tubing fits my interest in practical repair supplies: it serves a clear sealing purpose alongside the connectors I already bought."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The feeler gauge, cutting wheels and battery lugs require specific tasks or compatible equipment that my purchases do not establish I need.",
    "The magnets do not solve a mounting problem I currently have, and the COVID test does not connect to my repair needs.",
    "The other tubing kit is relevant, but I would choose just the adhesive-lined option; the glue also fits my interests, but ten tubes exceed my current need."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying repair supplies seems to have been taken as interest in any workshop tool, even when it serves a very different task.",
    "My connector and adhesive purchases seem to have been stretched into a need for heavy battery terminals and bulk glue without enough connection to my actual projects."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "A useful next purchase should work with supplies I already have, such as insulation and sealing materials for my wire connectors.",
    "Specific application, equipment compatibility and quantity matter: an item can fit my general interests without being something I need now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my practical repair interests but often assumed specific projects and quantities beyond what my purchases support."
}
